FairTix appears to be an anti-scalping ticketing platform that uses verified human queues and transparent pricing to combat bots and hidden fees. The workflow connects Google Sheets (lottery winner tracking) with Gmail (customer notifications), suggesting this is either a startup or demo system rather than enterprise-scale operations. The high error rate (36%) indicates significant reliability issues that could severely damage customer trust and revenue conversion.
